summaries.Good news: Real breakthroughs today in health and human connection—a seizure-free infant, families reunited across decades, and a neighbor's heroic rescue. These are stories of resilience and kindness that remind us what matters most.
summaries.Ideas: The tech industry faces reckoning as Jensen Huang's resignation exposes leadership blind spots, while startups are quietly solving climate challenges and humanizing AI through better design and storytelling.
summaries.Technology: From breakthrough stroke prevention drugs to robotic EV charging and the first underwater amusement park ride, innovation is accelerating across health, transport, and entertainment—though outages remind us the infrastructure still has fragilities.
summaries.Design: Architecture and UX are being reimagined for social impact—refugee settlements becoming economic hubs, markets serving 20,000 vendors in Kinshasa, and wayfinding that speaks to Gen Z sensibilities. Meanwhile, 3D-printed furniture and modular design are democratizing custom manufacturing.
